items.stem: What is meant by "Subscribed capital"?
items.answer: The part of issued capital that has been actually subscribed (taken up) by the public.

items.stem: Distinguish between equity shares and preference shares on the basis of voting rights, rate of dividend, preference in dividend and return of capital on winding up.
items.answer: (i) Voting rights: equity shares: normal voting rights on all matters; preference shares: vote only on matters affecting their rights. (ii) Rate of dividend: equity shares: varies with profit; preference shares: fixed rate. (iii) Preference in dividend: equity shares: paid after preference dividend; preference shares: paid before equity dividend. (iv) Return of capital on winding up: equity shares: returned after preference capital; preference shares: returned before equity capital.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each basis: (i) Voting rights: equity shares: normal voting rights on all matters; preference shares: vote only on matters affecting their rights. (ii) Rate of dividend: equity shares: varies with profit; preference shares: fixed rate. (iii) Preference in dividend: equity shares: paid after preference dividend; preference shares: paid before equity dividend. (iv) Return of capital on winding up: equity shares: returned after preference capital; preference shares: returned before equity capital.

items.stem: Sunrise Industries Ltd offered 1,60,000 shares of ₹10 each at a premium of ₹3, payable ₹3 on application and ₹6 (including premium) on allotment, the rest on calls. Applications were received for 3,20,000 shares and shares were allotted pro rata; excess application money was adjusted towards allotment and any surplus refunded. Aditi applied for 4,260 shares. How many shares will Aditi get and how much will Aditi pay on allotment?
items.answer: 2,130 shares; pays ₹6,390 on allotment
items.markingKey: Pro-rata 3,20,000:1,60,000 = 2:1; shares allotted 4,260 ÷ 2:1 = 2,130. Paid on application 4,260 × ₹3 = ₹12,780; needed ₹6,390; excess ₹6,390. Due on allotment 2,130 × ₹6 = ₹12,780; less excess = ₹6,390.
